name: James I Manning Jr

bio.statement: In his pamphlet statement, Manning lists his occupation as State Senator, with a background as a nonprofit director and retired US Army.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Senator Occupational Background: Nonprofit Director, Ret. US Army

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Lane edition (Book 4), p. 40

positions.statement: The statement says Manning supports equitable housing policies that reduce cost, protect data privacy and prevent homelessness.
positions.excerpt: Sen. Manning supports equitable housing policies that reduce cost, protect privacy of our data, and prevent homelessness.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Lane edition (Book 4), p. 40

positions.statement: The statement says Manning advanced funding for a behavioral health stabilization center for people in acute mental health crisis.
positions.excerpt: Sen. Manning has advanced funding for a behavorial health stabliza-tion center for persons suffering an acute mental health crisis so they can get the treatment and support they need.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Lane edition (Book 4), p. 40

positions.statement: The statement says Manning established the Universal Health Plan Governance Board.
positions.excerpt: Sen. Manning established the Universal Health Plan Governance Board, putting Oregon on track to be the first state to offer a Medicare/Medicaid-like universal healthcare system for all Oregonians.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Lane edition (Book 4), p. 40

positions.statement: The statement says Manning chairs a Senate committee on veterans, emergency management, federal and world affairs and champions wildfire resilience, first responders and veterans' services.
positions.excerpt: As Chair of this Senate Committee, Sen. Manning champions wildfire resiliance, needs of first responders, and protecting veterans’ services.
